name: robinhood-options-mobile
description: An Android and iOS mobile app implementing the Robinhood and Schwab APIs using the Flutter SDK.

paragraphs: RealizeAlpha is a professional-grade Flutter mobile app for multi-account brokerage management (Robinhood, Schwab, Fidelity), featuring AI-powered trade signals, automated agentic trading, and institutional-grade options analytics including Gamma Exposure (GEX) and institutional flow tracking.
features: v0.57.0 Highlights: Auto-Trade Settings Persistence & Signal Re-Evaluation (#234): entry/exit settings and the signal interval stay saved, and rejected signals are re-evaluated when entry rules change.

v0.56.0 Highlights: Retirement Planning & Gold Match Maximizer (#139); Auto-Trade Reliability & Paper Ledger Repair (#234) with indicator-based signal matching, exit oversell protection, push throttling, and admin…

v0.55.1 Highlights: Autonomous Agentic Risk Copilot with continuous gap risk, earnings hazards, and delta hedge monitoring (#118); Multi-Leg Spread Builder & Order Entry Templates for Verticals, Straddles, Strangles,…

Brokerage Integration: Connects securely to brokerage accounts (e.g., Robinhood) to fetch real-time data. New: Native Robinhood first-party API extensions for institutional hedge fund holdings, officer/director insider…

Model Context Protocol (MCP) Client: Secure, local MCP Dart client enabling conversational AI agents to discover, inspect, and execute real-time brokerage actions (fetching balances, positions, orders, or watchlists)…

whatItDoes.text: RealizeAlpha is a professional-grade Flutter mobile app for multi-account brokerage management (Robinhood, Schwab, Fidelity), featuring AI-powered trade signals, automated agentic trading, and institutional-grade options analytics including Gamma Exposure (GEX) and institutional flow tracking.

requirements.text: Progressive Portfolio: Decision-focused overview answering what happened and what needs attention through hero statistics, an account-aware Action Center, movers, and capped holdings summaries.

AI-Powered Insights & Local MCP Tooling: Leverages Generative AI (upgraded to Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite for lowest token cost, low latency, and high-throughput execution) to provide analysis on market data (e.g., AI Price Targets and chart trends) with personalized investment profile integration.

Instrument-Specific Buying Power & Trade Warnings: Real-time buying power per instrument (/accounts/{account}/instrumentbuyingpower/{id}/) with margin requirement tags (50% Marginable, 100% Cash Required), short-selling limits, and regulatory trade warnings (/instruments/{id}/v2/warnings/).
